decision: Support an optional versioned allowlisted rich-text JSON chapter envelope, validate it server-side on create/update, and render it with fixed safe HTML elements while preserving legacy plain-text and comic formats.
invariants: No raw author HTML is rendered or trusted.
Existing plain-text chapter content retains its escaped rendering path.
Existing comic chapter envelope and reader behavior remain separate.
Chapter authorization, ownership, draft status, locking and publication review remain unchanged.
No database migration or new dependency is introduced.
acceptance: Validator rejects unsupported node/mark types, invalid structure, unsafe links, excessive size, node count, depth and text length.
Chapter POST and PATCH validate recognized rich-text envelopes.
Reader renders only fixed allowlisted elements and escapes all author text and links.
Existing plain-text and comic reader paths remain intact.
Build runs the new policy test.
releaseBoundary: Structured content validation and reader compatibility only. No Tiptap editor UI, production deployment, or D1 mutation.
